security_audit.summary: Most static backtick findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline model IDs, and prompt examples. The installer command at SKILL.md:21 is confirmed critical because it pipes remote network content into sh. No prompt injection or covert data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Remote installer script is piped directly into the shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the pipe-to-shell command with signed package-manager steps, checksum verification, or a link to manual installation instructions.

remediation.issue: Executable download URL is used without integrity verification.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a release version and publish a checksum or signature verification step before any installer runs.

remediation.issue: Related skill examples use executable npx install commands.
remediation.suggestion: Move related skill installation to manual documentation and require explicit user confirmation before running install commands.

content.value_statement: Product teams need polished images for listings, ads, and mockups without a full studio shoot. This skill provides prompt patterns and inference.sh workflows for commercial product imagery.
actual_capabilities: Provides inference.sh CLI examples for FLUX Dev, FLUX Schnell, Imagen 3, Grok, and Seedream image models.
Supplies prompt patterns for studio, lifestyle, hero, flat lay, and action product scenes.
Covers product categories such as electronics, fashion, beauty, food, furniture, and jewelry.
Includes lighting guidance for soft studio light, rim light, natural light, and high contrast scenes.
Shows workflows for batch angle generation, upscaling, and background removal.
limitations: Requires an inference.sh CLI installation, account access, and model availability.
Generated images may not exactly match a real product without strong references or review.
The skill does not verify licensing, platform compliance, or claim accuracy for generated images.
The installer example should be reviewed manually because it downloads and runs a remote script.

use_cases.title: Generate Listing Images
use_cases.description: Create clean white-background and lifestyle prompt directions for marketplace product listings.

use_cases.title: Plan Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Draft hero, flat lay, and action-shot concepts for ads, landing pages, and social campaigns.

use_cases.title: Prototype Product Mockups
use_cases.description: Explore visual styles, lighting choices, and product angles before booking a studio shoot.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Studio Shot
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a clean studio product photo prompt for a [product] on a white background with soft lighting and sharp focus.

prompt_templates.title: Lifestyle Listing Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a lifestyle product photo prompt for a [product] used in a realistic [setting], with natural lighting and clear scale.

prompt_templates.title: Brand Campaign Hero
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a premium campaign image prompt for a [product], including background, lighting, composition, and space for headline text.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Angle Production Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a coordinated image set for a [product] with front, side, detail, lifestyle, and hero views using one consistent brand style.

output_examples.input: Create an Amazon main image direction for a stainless steel water bottle.
output_examples.output: A white-background studio direction with the bottle centered, soft shadows, accurate scale, sharp focus, and no text or graphics.

output_examples.input: Create a lifestyle image direction for a skincare serum.
output_examples.output: A spa-inspired scene with natural stone props, water droplets, soft daylight, premium beauty styling, and clear product visibility.

output_examples.input: Create a hero banner direction for wireless headphones.
output_examples.output: A dramatic tech campaign concept with rim lighting, a clean gradient background, premium materials, and open space for web copy.

best_practices: Define product type, background, lighting, style, and technical quality in every request.
Keep lighting and styling consistent across all images in one product line.
Review generated images for product accuracy, platform rules, and brand compliance before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague prompts that omit product material, scale, lighting, or background.
Do not publish generated product images without checking accuracy against the real item.
Do not run installer or related-skill commands automatically without user review.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create prompts and inference.sh workflows for commercial product images, listing photos, lifestyle scenes, and mockups.

faq.question: Which image models does it reference?
faq.answer: It references FLUX Dev, FLUX Schnell, Imagen 3, Grok, Seedream, and related image post-processing apps.

faq.question: Can it create marketplace-ready images?
faq.answer: It can guide image generation for marketplace formats, but final images still need human review for rules and accuracy.

faq.question: Does it require an external service?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples use the inference.sh CLI and hosted image generation models.

faq.question: Can it match a real product exactly?
faq.answer: Exact matching is not guaranteed. Use strong references and inspect outputs before using them commercially.

faq.question: Is the installation command safe to run automatically?
faq.answer: No. The remote installer command should be reviewed and replaced with verified manual installation steps.
